action: Four searches and a museum site that looks like 2003. A glass-case photo from three angles: a three-pointed dark stone, size of a fist, a face carved on the front, on the back a spiral opening into a triangle. Card: Zemí (cemí), Dominican Republic, c. 1000–1500. The Taíno thought of a cemí as a spirit and the thing the spirit lived in, both at once.
